A Fantastic Find
Nov 2019 • Friends
Firstly the owner has a great sense of humour- the sign on the door says “Free Wash with Camel Parking”. If you were in Morocco, for which the cuisine is based, it would be a bonus. For us, the food was all that was needed. A focus on Tajine and wonderfully flavoursome salads sets this restaurant apart from its neighbours. The meals are authentic and of course ideal for sharing. The size of the dishes is just right and allows for a wider choice rather than limited to one or two large servings. The dishes we ordered all were both full of flavour yet subtle and not overpowering the core ingredients. The Kofta tajine was a stand out. The only slight negative was a limited wine list, which the owner advised was a work in progress. This is a wonderful intimate and casual restaurant. A place where you feel at home with the added advantage that you don’t have to cook or clean up.

A Delight for Vegetarians in HCMC
Sep 2019
We visited Casablanca after a recommendation. I am a veggie but enjoy eating in restaurants which serve the full (i.e. meat) menu. Starters were great (mixed dips and some very 'fresh' deep brief camembert. Star of the show was the veggie tagine which I had to insist was kept on the table to be mopped up with some extra bread. All washed down with a local microbrew ale (also recommended) and a slightly odd but refreshing and enjoyable red from Morocco.

Great Food at a great price - authentic
Sep 2019
Together with three team members we had lunch at Casablanca last week. We each ordered different dishes from the wide set lunch proposition. From the start, I could not believe it to be so affordable, 10 USD for a two course set lunch like this, is a good deal. I ordered a three dip starter, and each dip was really tasty. Regretted not having proper local breads, but it was still great and I finished each dip. For main, I took a meat pastilla. It took 20mn to get it, but this was a blessing. So big and so tasty. The accompanying mint tea did not disappoint either, actually better as it was not a sweet as it is often in other places. The setting is cosy and friendly, colorful as you can expect it to be. This restaurant is recommended at lunch and most likely in the evening when the sun set. It must be romantic then. look forward to be back.

Must try if you are willing to explore
Jun 2019 • Family
We intended to head for a Thai place given my wife’s fatigue with veg options at a standard Pho place. While in cab we just happened to see this place and decided to stop by for lunch on our first day at HCM. 

Casablanca as name suggests serves Moroccan cuisine. Very nicely done up (ref pictures). 
The menu is pricey given its location and decor. Food is a mixed bag. Some good dishes offset by some not so good ones.

We ordered a couple of dishes. 
Good & great Chicken Skewer, Hummus & Veg Tajines.
Not so great - Seafood Paella, lacked flavour probably no saffron.
Needs real improvement - Casablanca Delight. Terribly sweet and was very ordinary. Wouldn’t recommend at all.

Drinks - Beer on tap is pricey and best avoided.. 

Service is excellent. 

Def worth a visit if you are looking for options in HCM / Vietnam.
